name: inkFolders
author: inkeddev

sections.description:
inkFolders adds a clean, fast, and intuitive folder system for WordPress posts, pages, and media.

Use a visual sidebar tree to create folders, filter content, and drag items into folders directly from WordPress admin list tables.

Features

  • Hierarchical folder tree with nested folders
  • Drag-and-drop organization
  • Sidebar folder filtering for posts, pages, and media
  • Inline folder pills inside list tables
  • Collapse and expand folder branches
  • Show or hide the sidebar instantly
  • Visual folder colors
  • Unassigned view for finding content without a folder
  • No external dependencies

Supported Content

  • Posts
  • Pages
  • Media Library

Technical Notes

  • Admin filter query var: ink_folder
  • REST API namespace: inkfol/v1
  • No external dependencies
  • Designed for WordPress admin list tables

Roadmap

  • Folder search
  • Bulk actions
  • Folder permissions
  • UI customization options
  • Expanded custom post type support

License

GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/inkfolders directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin.
  3. Open Posts, Pages, or Media Library to use the inkFolders sidebar.
sections.faq:
Does inkFolders replace categories or tags?

No. inkFolders uses its own folder taxonomy and does not replace WordPress categories or tags.

Can I organize media files?

Yes. inkFolders supports the WordPress Media Library.

Does inkFolders add anything to the front end of my site?

No. inkFolders is designed for WordPress admin organization.

Where can I report bugs or request help?

For bug reports or plugin feedback, contact inkfolders@inktopaw.ca.
